title: Department of Homeland Security: Phase 56K Exact-Record Decision
publisher: Department of Homeland Security Office of Inspector General
summary: The current DHS OIG public report index does not expose a final FY 2025 enterprise FISMA evaluation. Previously captured component and vulnerability-management records remain adjacent evidence and do not replace the named enterprise result. Phase 56K decision: Retain Open. No exact enterprise-wide FY 2025 evaluation or dated replacement outcome was identified on the authoritative public rail.
key_findings: Named record: Released FY 2025 enterprise FISMA evaluation.
Continuation rule: Reopen when DHS OIG publishes the final FY 2025 enterprise evaluation or a dated replacement outcome.
why_it_matters: The decision records an exact acquisition result, including a verified non-closure, without substituting an adjacent record.
ftfn_relevance: Separates current record status from entity performance.
Keeps denominator, attribution, limitation, and reopening rule attached.
evidence_limits: A dated public-index check is a publication-boundary observation, not proof that no nonpublic work exists and not the missing annual result.
Final FY 2025 DHS enterprise FISMA evaluation, finding-level results, remediation status, incidents, recovery, and mission effects.
No causal effect, entity ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
